title: 真题演练 · 分词作状语
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 分词作状语。

questions.q: ___ from the tower, the city looks smaller.
questions.analysis: city 是被看的,用过去分词 Seen。

questions.q: ___ the door, he went into the room.
questions.analysis: he 主动开门,用现在分词 Opening。
先完成作业再看电视,用 Having finished。

questions.q: The exam ___, the students felt relieved.
questions.analysis: 独立主格中 exam 被完成,用过去分词 finished。

questions.q: ___ by the accident, he couldn't drive again.
questions.analysis: he 被吓到,用过去分词 Terrified。

questions.q: 判断对错:Encouraging by his words, she kept going.
questions.analysis: 应改为:Encouraged by his words, she kept going.。she 是被鼓励的对象,要用过去分词 Encouraged。
